agent_explanation: Velocity-error law F=kp*m*(vcmd direction - v) plus seeded sensor noise demands ~105.5 N on step 1, exceeding fmax 81.18 N. The commanded force is applied/unreported without clamping to fmax, so controller_force_limit is violated immediately. Lowering kp alone removes the violation, confirming unclamped gain-driven demand is the cause.
